name: United℠ Explorer Card

loungeAccess.notes: 2 complimentary United Club one-time passes per year (not full membership). Good for 1 visit each, not unlimited access.

tripDelay.notes: Delay must be 12+ hours or require overnight stay. Up to $500 per ticket purchased on card.

tripCancellation.notes: Up to $10,000 per person and $20,000 per trip for prepaid, non-refundable expenses.

lostBaggage.notes: Up to $3,000 per passenger per trip for lost, stolen, or damaged luggage. High-value items (jewelry, electronics) may be subject to $500 sub-limit.

baggageDelay.notes: Up to $100/day for 5 days when bags are delayed 6+ hours. Maximum $500.

travelAccidentInsurance.notes: Up to $500,000 accidental death and dismemberment when traveling as a passenger on a common carrier (air, bus, train, cruise).

emergencyMedical.notes: Travel and Emergency Assistance Services: 24/7 legal, medical, and emergency referrals. Emergency evacuation coordinated but cardholder typically responsible for costs unless purchased separately.

rentalCarInsurance.countries: Worldwide except certain countries excluded by Chase.
rentalCarInsurance.notes: Auto Rental Collision Damage Waiver (CDW) — PRIMARY coverage when you decline the rental company's CDW. Covers up to actual cash value of vehicle.

purchaseProtection.notes: Covers new purchases for 120 days — up to $500 per claim.

extendedWarranty.notes: Extends the time period of the U.S. manufacturer's warranty by an additional year on eligible warranties of 3 years or less.

rewards.diningRate: 2x miles at restaurants including eligible delivery services
rewards.hotelRate: 2x miles on hotel stays when booked directly
otherBonusCategories: 2x miles on all other travel purchases

pointValue.transferPartners: United MileagePlus — no direct transfers from other programs

annualCredits.name: Statement Credit (first-year fee waiver)
annualCredits.notes: Annual fee waived for the first year as of some promotional offers. Verify current offer at time of application.

freeCheckedBags.notes: First checked bag free for cardholder and one companion on the same reservation when flying United. Saves up to $35 per person each way.

priorityBoarding.notes: Board in Group 2 before general boarding.

unitedClubPasses.notes: 2 complimentary United Club one-time passes per year — use for lounge access on travel days.

upgradeEligibility.notes: Premier Access: priority check-in, security (where available), boarding, and baggage handling.

eliteStatusBenefits.pqpBonus: 500 Premier Qualifying Points (PQPs) after every $12,000 in purchases annually.
eliteStatusBenefits.notes: Earn PQPs to qualify for Premier status. PQP thresholds: Silver=4K, Gold=8K, Platinum=12K, 1K=24K.

travelPerks: Group 2 priority boarding on United flights
2 United Club one-time passes per year
Premier Access (priority check-in, security, boarding, baggage)
$100 Global Entry / TSA PreCheck / NEXUS credit every 4 years
Baggage delay up to $100/day for 5 days
2x miles on United purchases, hotels, dining, and travel
500 PQPs per $12,000 spend toward Premier status
bestFor: United loyalists who want free checked bags and priority boarding at a budget-friendly annual fee
